name: CWF Genocide

matches.stipulation: Texas Tornado rules, point elimination: each man pinned, submitted or disqualified earns his team a point and may no longer eliminate anyone; a team with two points is out
matches.title: cwf-chaotic-tag-team
matches.note: The Hit Squad kept the Tag Team titles. Roman Steeler pinned John Thomas, X-Factor pinned Fuel, Jake Fury pinned Roman Steeler and then X-Factor to eliminate Generation Xtreme, and The Punk's quick rollup in the final exchange gave the Hit Squad the win. A hallway segment of Priest meeting Christian Connolly follows.

Hirvon won with the moonsault (Hirvon's Hell) after the double clothesline and a run-in by The Punk and Roman Steeler for Vash, answered by Carnage; Hirvon dropped Roman Steeler with a Black Hole Slam.

matches.title: cwf-chaotic-cruiserweight
matches.note: Carnage, brought out by Hirvon, ran from the opening bell and was eliminated by Ken Sandwave; Michael Machete then pinned Sandwave with the frog splash to keep the title.

matches.stipulation: Gauntlet match: two Divas fight until one is pinned or submits, then the next enters
matches.title: cwf-chaotic-womens
matches.note: Faith, the champion, beat Lexi, Kira and Skye Estado in turn, the last after Phil King distracted Skye, then lost to Syd Ashley, who had been clotheslined by Phil King on the way to the ring, after a swinging DDT and the Air Canada. Faith said she would retire after the night.

matches.stipulation: 60 minute Iron Man match, no countouts and no disqualifications, with a fall counted for each pinfall, submission, countout or disqualification
matches.title: cwf-chaotic-international
matches.note: Connolly won five falls to four. Fuel took the first fall by Fujiwara armbar, Connolly levelled with the CDT, Fuel's chair shot gave Connolly a fall by disqualification, and the title changed hands when Fuel tapped to the CDT with one second left.

matches.stipulation: Special rules: neither man may leave the ring or cause a disqualification, on pain of an instant loss; special guest referee Violent A
matches.title: cwf-chaotic-world-heavyweight
matches.note: Priest kept the title with the Priest Driver, then took the announce table apart and powerbombed X-Factor through it; Violent A laid out John Thomas with Black Rain after Generation Xtreme attacked.

notes: A complete broadcast script with the commentary, entrances and scoreboard of each contest. It carries the return of Violent A after almost three and a half years, a 60-minute Iron Man match for the International title, a Women's title gauntlet and a World title match under special rules. A video recap of the Eliminator Elite 2005 finals (Faith, Steele, X-Factor) plays between matches and is not counted as a match of this night. A near-identical earlier draft of the same script (carrying a typing error and a different heading) is a separate file on the same site and is not served a second time.

name: CWF Ultimate Chaos

matches.title: cwf-chaotic-tag-team
matches.note: Generation Xtreme kept the Tag Team titles; Simon Steeler took the loss to the Xer. Jay D Scott was told to stay on the Hit Squad's corner for the entire bout.
Lexi beat the former Women's champion Syd Ashley in the continuation of their feud from the previous month's Shockwave.

matches.title: cwf-chaotic-cruiserweight
matches.note: Machete, a former Hit Squad member, kept the title against the group's newest member with the frog splash.
Roman Steeler won; the script's own result line is a summary.

matches.stipulation: Staff encounter triple threat elimination match, special guest referee Logan Kincaide
matches.note: Tommy Chaos was eliminated first and Jaymz Marshall won, per the script's own one-line staging note.

matches.title: cwf-chaotic-international
matches.note: The Punk took the title with a Punk DDT from nowhere after a back-and-forth match.

matches.title: cwf-chaotic-womens
matches.note: Faith kept the Women's title with Losing Faith.

matches.stipulation: Barbwire Massacre: a 16 foot cage wrapped in barbed wire, barbed wire on every chair, ladder, table, bat and post, barbed-wire ropes, pinfall only
matches.note: Jake Fury won in his own final match before retiring.

A pinfall and a submission came together in the last seconds and the referee ruled a draw on the time limit; both teams were raised and left together. Dazz and Violent A had not teamed in several years.

matches.title: cwf-chaotic-world-heavyweight
matches.note: Priest kept the World Heavyweight title with the Priest Driver after Slipknot and A Perfect Circle performed live for the entrances; he struck a referee and waved off the medical staff, and shook John Thomas's hand afterwards.

notes: The script of the federation's last show, still a working draft: the writer's own placeholders (ADD INTROS, WRITE MATCH, BUILDUP, SEGMENT - ???) stand in several places and most results are given as one-line summaries rather than full action. Its own commentary says the Chairman sold his majority shares the month before, that this is the last event the company will host, and that the buyer will rename and reopen it as Motor City Wrestling in Detroit. Showbiz Stooeh vs The Lokian and Phil King vs Synn vs Fear are listed on the card with no result or text, and are not counted as matches. The file name of the page's empty shell reads 01042007 while the script's own title reads April 3rd 2007; the title is used here.
